changes.purpose: Create the persistent accepted normative-requirement registry produced from accepted normative changes.
implementation: Represent each accepted requirement once with stable identity, statement, lifecycle, Conformance applicability, and Assurance applicability.
Do not copy assertion lists or review-obligation lists into requirement records; derive those relationships from Conformance and Assurance registries.
Support deterministic loading and uniqueness checks.

changes.purpose: Materialize the compact accepted Framework Contract that establishes authority topology and keystone delegation.
implementation: Declare repo/ as the framework authority namespace.
Declare exactly Governance, Conformance, and Assurance as authority-bearing keystones.
Declare the authority domain and prohibited authority of each keystone.
Declare framework/product authority separation and no implicit authority creation.

changes.purpose: Install schemas and runtime-readable contracts for functional sets and closed Plan graphs while retaining this Genesis Plan intact.
implementation: Define functional-set schema with kinds genesis, core, and extension.
Enforce exactly the Genesis predecessor rule: genesis has no predecessor; non-genesis functional sets require the predecessor form applicable to their lifecycle.
Define plan root references and subordinate document schemas.
Define normative-change records as candidate change authority distinct from persistent requirements.
Define file-change records with explicit paths, operations, requirement relationships, implementation intent, and dependencies.

changes.purpose: Provide mechanical parsing and structural validation for Design Proposal metadata and statement addressing.
implementation: Parse canonical Markdown Design Proposal metadata and explicit statement IDs without converting Markdown into independent semantic authority.
Validate required identity syntax and uniqueness.
Resolve selected Design statement IDs from the exact proposal revision bound by a functional set.

changes.purpose: Load accepted framework authority and expose deterministic requirement and delegation lookup.
implementation: Load framework contract and requirement registry.
Reject duplicate requirement IDs and malformed applicability.
Expose accepted requirement lookup without inferring authority from implementation or Git history.

changes.purpose: Load and validate the closed functional-set/Plan graph.
implementation: Resolve every referenced Plan subdocument.
Validate Genesis/root and successor predecessor rules.
Validate selected Design statement existence against exact revisions.
Validate unique planned paths and explicit operations.
Expose authorized mutation set independently of validation orchestration.

changes.purpose: Provide minimal explicit Planning/Build acceptance and accepted-state advancement.
implementation: Model acceptance as an explicit decision distinct from Conformance or Assurance success.
Apply accepted normative changes to the persistent authority registry during accepted state construction.
Advance accepted state only after required stage evidence is satisfied.
Do not implement the complete later Governance lifecycle.

changes.purpose: Create persistent Conformance registries for assertions, implementations, and orchestration.
implementation: Maintain assertion records containing assertion identity, exactly one requirement owner, predicate description, and gating flag.
Maintain implementation bindings as the only persisted assertion-to-implementation relationship.
Allow one implementation to bind multiple assertions.
Maintain orchestration as implementation reachability without separately duplicating assertion membership.
Derive correspondence from accepted requirement applicability plus assertion ownership.

changes.purpose: Implement the shared canonical Conformance engine.
implementation: Load accepted requirements and Conformance registries.
Check applicability/coverage, assertion ownership, implementation binding, and orchestration reachability.
Execute implementations and require exactly one result for each required executed assertion.
Emit structured assertion-level findings.
Return PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE with configuration/runtime defects distinguished from assertion failure.

changes.purpose: Expose one stable public repository Conformance entry point.
implementation: Be a thin adapter over the shared Conformance runtime engine.
Support concise human output and machine-readable JSON output.
Propagate engine disposition through stable process exit codes.
Contain no independent normative predicate logic.

changes.purpose: Create minimal persistent Assurance correspondence and review-obligation state.
implementation: Derive Assurance applicability from accepted requirements without duplicating normative text.
Maintain review obligations separately from requirement identity.
Represent review cases with explicit authorizing authority, review subject, exercised obligations, evidence references, and findings.
Keep findings bounded to the review case.

changes.purpose: Support minimal Planning and Build Assurance needed for successor framework work.
implementation: Load review obligations applicable to the governed stage.
Validate review-case structure mechanically while preserving semantic judgment for the reviewer.
Record attributable findings and case disposition.
Do not convert findings into normative authority.

changes.purpose: Provide bounded Build realization under one accepted Plan.
implementation: Load exactly one accepted Plan.
Compute the authorized mutation set from file changes.
Reject observed mutations outside that set.
Produce a machine-readable mutation manifest.
Invoke the same Conformance engine used by repo/scripts/validate and collect required Assurance evidence before acceptance.

changes.purpose: Represent the first and successor accepted repository states without dependence on prototype provenance.
implementation: Represent accepted repository revision and acceptance identity needed for internal successor lineage.
Do not require source-repository URL, prototype commit ancestry, or external pre-Genesis repository ancestry for authority.
Permit successor Planning to bind one exact accepted repository state.

changes.purpose: Provide focused implementation evidence for Genesis framework mechanisms.
implementation: Test positive, rejection, and boundary behavior for each implemented framework mechanism.
Do not treat broad test-suite success as a substitute for requirement-owned assertions.
Include a successor-framework functional-set fixture proving normal post-Genesis workflow.

changes.purpose: Create the portable human entry point for the repo-spec Genesis seed.
implementation: Identify the repository as the portable repo-spec framework seed established through FS0-GENESIS.
Explain that FS0-GENESIS is the unique framework-root functional set while FS0-CORE is a product-root concept.
Describe the repository authority, Design, Planning, Build, Conformance, Assurance, and accepted-state surfaces at a high level without duplicating their normative semantics.
Document repo/scripts/validate as the canonical public Conformance entry point once realized.
Explain that later framework capabilities are implemented through ordinary successor functional sets rather than by modifying Genesis semantics.

changes.purpose: Create portable contributor and AI-agent operating guidance at repository root.
implementation: Direct contributors to treat accepted authority under repo/ as controlling over implementation behavior, historical convention, generated output, or reviewer preference.
State that Design owns semantics, Planning owns normative distillation and implementation intent, and Build owns implementation correctness.
Require routing upstream when missing semantics, scope, normative intent, or planned mutation authority is discovered.
Require use of the accepted Plan for Build scope and repo/scripts/validate for canonical mechanical Conformance.
Make the guidance explicitly non-authoritative and subordinate to accepted repository authority.

changes.purpose: Create the durable legal licensing artifact that accompanies the portable Genesis seed.
implementation: Populate LICENSE with the complete GNU General Public License version 3 text.
Treat LICENSE as legal distribution/reuse text, not repository-framework normative authority.
Do not derive framework semantics from the license text.
